description: xtermium's nightly build: main as it stands, before a release carries it. Cross-platform terminal and session manager with web/file browsers and AI.
notes: A nightly build takes the place of the release: run 'scoop uninstall xtermium' first if it is installed.
It opens the release's data, in the Scoop folder persist/xtermium (XTERMIUM_HOME), which uninstalling leaves alone.
Keep a backup you trust: Settings > Import and export > Back up everything.
Run 'scoop config update_nightly true' once; 'scoop update xtermium-nightly' then gets the latest night's build (close xtermium first).
